notes.title: 《街机金蟾捕鱼2》新用户集红包赢京东卡活动
notes.content:
1、 Activity name



Set red envelope to win Jingdong card



2、 Activity time



New registered users can participate within 7 days from the date of registration



3、 Activity content



During the activity, you can get the super value Jingdong card when the number of shots reaches a certain level in the "Classic Fishing" special venue. It's absolutely cost-effective!



For novice fishing village, the number of red packets can be drawn: 1 time, and the maximum red envelope can be 10 yuan



The number of times you can draw a red envelope: 3 times, the maximum amount of a single red envelope is 10 yuan



Donghai Dragon Palace, the number of red packets can be drawn: 8 times, and the maximum amount of a single red envelope is 10 yuan



Sea monster abyss, the number of red packets can be drawn: 9 times, and the maximum amount of a single red packet is 10 yuan
